en: Use Prism as the English application name and 棱镜 in Chinese. One Windows installer offers English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese, with matching shortcut and uninstall names. Existing installation identity and data directories are retained.

First launch follows the installer language or system language. A manually selected app language remains saved across restarts and upgrades; changing it also updates existing Windows shortcuts for this installation. Deleted desktop shortcuts are not recreated.
macOS application names are localized for English and Chinese using the system language. Apple silicon and Intel installers include the same changes.
zh: 英文应用名称统一为 Prism，中文保持棱镜。Windows 共用一个安装包，可选择英文、简体中文或繁体中文，快捷方式与卸载名称随安装语言显示，沿用原安装身份和数据目录。
首次启动采用安装语言或系统语言；手动选择的应用语言会在重启和升级后保留，并更新此安装位置已有的 Windows 快捷方式名称。已主动删除的桌面快捷方式不会重建。
macOS 应用名称随系统语言显示为 Prism 或棱镜，Apple 芯片与 Intel 安装包同步提供。
